title: Hide "block sleep and screen locking after inactivity" UI section when both sleep and screen locking are disabled
line: The Power and Battery popup no longer shows the sleep and screen locking block switch when nothing happens after inactivity anyway.
explanation: The popup always showed the "Manually Block Sleep and Screen Locking" section, even when the system was set to never sleep, dim, turn off or lock the screen after inactivity, so the switch did nothing. The applet had no way to know which idle actions powerdevil had loaded. The daemon now answers isActionActive over D-Bus; the applet asks it about sleep, dimming and screen turn-off (again on every profile change), reads the screen locker's Autolock setting (watching kscreenlockerrc), and hides the section when none of them is on, unless a manual block is still active so it can be undone.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: hide sleep blocking when nothing happens on idle

The "Manually Block Sleep and Screen Locking" section was always shown,
even when the system never sleeps, dims, turns off or locks the screen
after inactivity. Hide it then, unless a manual block is still active.

BUG: 502912

media.caption: Master: sleep, dimming, screen turn-off and auto-lock are all disabled, yet the block switch is shown
Same settings with the fix: the section is gone
Turning automatic screen locking back on brings the section back right away
A manual block started by middle-clicking the tray icon keeps the section visible so it can be switched off
